facts.text: The UK CCAV-funded Sim4CAMSens program ran from 2023 to 2025.
facts.quote: The UK CCAV-funded Sim4CAMSens program (2023 to 2025)

facts.text: The UK CCAV-funded Sim4CAMSens program reports laboratory, field and proving-ground tests of camera, radar and lidar across varied conditions for simulation qualification; this is on-road evidence.
facts.quote: reports laboratory, field and proving-ground tests of camera, radar and lidar across varied conditions for simulation qualification

facts.text: The public summary of the Sim4CAMSens program does not provide enough sensor-by-sensor, condition-by-condition error data to establish a universal simulation fidelity level; the evidence is on-road.
facts.quote: the public summary does not give enough sensor-by-sensor, condition-by-condition error data to establish a universal fidelity level
